title: Exact concrete open-image complex on an arbitrary union
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U,V\subseteq X$ arbitrary opens, and $I$ a cochain complex of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] such that $I^n$ is injective for every $n\in\mathbf Z$. Write $J_T$ for the constructed open-image complex and $\rho_{T,W}:J_T\to J_W$ for its fixed restriction morphisms [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data]. Define $f=(\rho_{U\cup V,U},\rho_{U\cup V,V}):J_{U\cup V}\to J_U\oplus J_V$ and $g=(\rho_{U,U\cap V},-\rho_{V,U\cap V}):J_U\oplus J_V\to J_{U\cap V}$. There exists a proof $h:f;g=0$ such that the short complex $\operatorname{ShortComplex.mk}(f,g,h)$ is short exact. No K-injectivity or derived localization is assumed.

source.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), 08BS (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open), and 079W (lemma-adjoint); displayed short exact complex on the union and its sectionwise exactness

proof.text: Use the sheaf-level union pullback in each degree. Its commutativity proves the two restriction composites agree, hence the pair followed by the signed difference is zero.

Injective restriction surjectivity makes the smaller-open unit epic. The unit-restriction identity gives epimorphy of each nested-image restriction, hence of the difference from the biproduct. The union pullback gives exactness and monicity. Transport its short exact short complex through the evaluation biproduct isomorphism and use HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact.

proof_origin.note: Compiled reduction to the sheaf-level arbitrary-union pullback. Epimorphy and degreewise biproduct transport are proved in the parent module.

Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.MayerVietorisSquare constructs a free additive sheaf short complex. The project KInjectiveMayerVietorisExact and Degreewise modules require U sup V = top and have first term I, rather than the image complex on the union.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeOpenUnionImageComplex_shortExact
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hI : ∀ n : ℤ, Injective (I.X n)) :
    let f := biprod.lift
      (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ V)) I)
      (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X (homOfLE (le_sup_right : V ≤ U ⊔ V)) I)
    let g := biprod.desc
      (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)) I)
      (-(schemeOpenModuleImageComplexRestriction X (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)) I))
    ∃ h : f ≫ g = 0, (ShortComplex.mk f g h).ShortExact
